title: Amend the version-moved CI guard to accept a stacked-release CHANGELOG entry
summary: Resolves a real conflict between OPAG-32's existing 'plugin content changed means the version moved' CI guard and OPAG-65's release freeze (OPAG-52/62/63 land on dev without a version bump, folding into one 0.4.0 release at wave 3). Adds CHANGELOG.md with an Unreleased section and scripts/check-changelog-fold.mjs, which the guard now calls: content changing with the version unchanged passes if Unreleased documents it; a version bump now also requires Unreleased to be empty (folded into the new version's section), closing the new failure mode this rule adds -- a bump that leaves stale entries unfolded to ride along into the next release too. Both directions negative-tested per opum-agent's ruling on the conflict.
finalSummary: Added CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased + 0.3.2 sections) and scripts/check-changelog-fold.mjs, exporting extractUnreleased() and checkRelease() for testability. Amended ci.yml's 'Plugin content changed means the version moved' step to call the new script instead of failing outright: passes if either the version moved (and Unreleased is now empty, folded) or content changed with the version unchanged but Unreleased documents it. 8/8 tests pass in scripts/test/check-changelog-fold.test.mjs, covering both the original OPAG-32 defect shape and the new fold-on-bump requirement. Existing check-federated-pins and check-evals suites unaffected.
